# Copilot project entry point

For every substantial task, read `.github/project-instructions.md` and `.github/project-status.md` first. Consult `.github/TOOL_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md` for PDF-tool or shared-component work, and `.github/adsense-readiness-checklist.md` when a task affects its recorded checks.

Inspect the actual source and configuration before relying on project notes. Extend the existing application without unnecessary rewrites or unapproved dependencies/services. After meaningful implementation work, update the appropriate documentation, verify saved Markdown changes, run relevant available checks, and report only outcomes that were actually confirmed.
